name: C2b1a2a1
description: C2b1a2a1 is an intermediate subclade of C2b1a2a (M77), leading toward C2b1a2a1b (F6379). It represents a further Bronze Age differentiation within the non-Star-Cluster Mongolic C2b1a2 lineage.
interestingFact: The nested C2b1a2a1 → C2b1a2a1b structure reflects the demographic complexity of the Mongolian Plateau during the Bronze and early Iron Ages, when multiple distinct Mongolic patrilines co-existed and diverged.
